# aeneid-044 — new house renderings

No new house renderings.

For the reviewer (not proposed as house renderings): the best-known line of the part, VI.460 *invitus, regina, tuo de litore cessi*, was built from the Latin alone:
- `l`: "unwilling, queen, from your shore I departed."
- `i`: "it was against my will, my queen, that I went from your shores."
Please check it against memory of the well-known modern versions for verbatim echo.
